lines.text: Many learners say: Is there a bank near?
Better: Is there a bank near here?
The second! Is there a bank near here?

data.right: Is there a bank near here?

options: Is there a bank near here?

native.tip: في العربية نقول «هل يوجد بنك قريب؟» بـ«قريب» فقط، أما بالإنجليزية فنقول near here: “Is there a bank near here?” وليس “Is there a bank near?”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “Is there a bank near?” 😅 في العربية نقول «هل يوجد بنك قريب؟» بكلمة «قريب» وحدها، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول near here، فالجملة الصحيحة “Is there a bank near here?” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “near here” — نقول: “Is there a bank near here?” قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «هل يوجد بنك قريب؟» with just «قريب», but in English we say near here: “Is there a bank near here?” not “Is there a bank near?”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Is there a bank near?” 😅 In Arabic we say «هل يوجد بنك قريب؟» with just «قريب», but in English we say near here, so the right sentence is “Is there a bank near here?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
